playback.decoder: AVFoundation for native and prepared media
playback.trackSelection: First enabled usable video track, otherwise first usable video track; playback, Core Image filtering, metadata, and navigation use the same track

playbackIntent.startupGate: Generation- and intent-revision-scoped; transient paused reports are protected until playing settles the gate or the bounded grace period expires
playbackIntent.expiredStartup: A transport still paused at expiry returns the model to Paused unless a playback seek or scrub owns the handoff
playbackIntent.deferredResume: EOF-replay and scrub seek completions resume only when authorized by the current intent revision; a newer Pause cancels and a newer Play reauthorizes the existing handoff without a competing transport start
playbackIntent.transportGuard: Physical AVPlayer playing is permitted only for current Play intent outside scrubbing and with no playback seek handoff pending

frameNavigation.exactSource: Presentation timestamps from the selected native or prepared video track
frameNavigation.estimatedFallback: Clearly labeled constant-rate estimate while indexing, when exact sample cursors are unavailable, or when the exact-sample limit is exceeded

webM.intermediate: Temporary ProRes 4444 MOV with PCM audio
webM.cancellation: Cooperative termination followed by bounded forced termination
webM.cleanup: Prepared intermediates are removed on failure, replacement, cancellation, termination, and stale-output startup cleanup

youtube.acceptedLinks: HTTPS youtube.com watch, shorts, embed, and live links; YouTube No-Cookie embed links; and youtu.be video links
youtube.consent: Explicit first-use privacy and terms consent before any YouTube request
youtube.consentPreference: Only the accepted privacy and terms notice version is stored locally; pasted links and viewing history are not retained
youtube.madeForKidsPreflight: Every video identifier is checked with YouTube Data API videos.list before player HTML is created; failure or unknown status fails closed
youtube.dataAPIDisclosure: The request query contains the parsed video identifier, the API key is sent in X-Goog-Api-Key, and Google necessarily receives ordinary HTTPS request/network metadata such as source IP
youtube.player: Privacy-enhanced YouTube IFrame Player in a nonpersistent WKWebView cleared before every embed
youtube.playerViewport: The WKWebView fills the video canvas and remains at least 200 by 200 points across supported window sizes; YouTube owns internal aspect fit and letterboxing
youtube.quality: YouTube adaptive quality; the supported embed API does not let Reframer force a quality level
youtube.filterAndTransformControls: Disabled from pending preflight through YouTube playback
youtube.lockMode: Unavailable from pending preflight through YouTube playback; an existing lock is automatically released so required player controls remain interactive
youtube.seekBehavior: Timeline drag previews seek without allowing seek-ahead; release and discrete seeks allow seek-ahead
youtube.audioPreferenceIsolation: YouTube ready-state snapshots do not overwrite saved native-media volume or mute preferences
youtube.muteBehavior: Mute uses the official player mute state without setting retained player volume to zero, so the embedded player's Unmute restores the prior audible level
youtube.websiteDataStore: Nonpersistent session data may exist while the player runs; it is cleared before every embed and is never persisted

globalShortcuts.toggleLockAvailability: Local media only; unavailable from pending YouTube preflight through playback
globalShortcuts.toggleLockRegistration: Registered in every video and lock state; suspended only during shortcut recording and removed on shutdown
globalShortcuts.lockEntryRequirement: The exact configured global Lock/Unlock chord must be registered before whole-overlay click-through can begin
globalShortcuts.lockEntryFailure: Lock is refused and recovery guidance identifies the configured chord
globalShortcuts.lockRecoveryLoss: Registration loss, conflict, recording suspension, or disabling global shortcuts while locked immediately unlocks the overlay and reports recovery
globalShortcuts.frameStepAvailability: Loaded local media with lock mode enabled and exact or estimated sample navigation available
globalShortcuts.frameStepRegistration: Registered only while frame stepping is actionable
globalShortcuts.inactiveFrameStepHandling: Not registered, received, or swallowed through Reframer's global path while another app is active
globalShortcuts.failureRecovery: Shortcut Settings reports conflicts and offers retry

shortcutSettings.layout: One shared five-column grid aligns enabled state, shortcut, action, multiplier, and clear controls across every section
shortcutSettings.focus: Row-major keyboard traversal; Tab is never captured as a shortcut
shortcutSettings.persistence: Validated window size and shortcut bindings persist

overlay.windowModel: One canonical externally managed window contains the video and control bar
overlay.unlockedExternalManagement: macOS and third-party window managers such as Mosaic move and resize the entire overlay

layout.visibility: Every control remains visible and accessibility-reachable in both layouts

overlay.unlockedAlwaysOnTopPreference: Persisted preference selects floating or normal level only while unlocked
overlay.lockedLevel: NSWindow.Level.statusBar above all ordinary application windows regardless of the unlocked preference
overlay.lockedPointerInput: The entire overlay, including video and controls, ignores pointer events
overlay.lockedMediaScope: Native or prepared local media only; YouTube must remain unlocked and interactive
overlay.unlockRecovery: The exact configured global Lock/Unlock chord restores interaction from another app; Reframer refuses lock without it and automatically unlocks if it becomes unavailable

documentation.renderer: Native AppKit attributed text rendered from bundled Help HTML
documentation.externalLinks: Allowlisted YouTube and Google policy links open in the system browser

privacy.networkScope: Only an explicit YouTube workflow contacts YouTube, Google APIs, and YouTube media hosts
privacy.remoteWebCode: Authorized YouTube playback downloads and executes IFrame API JavaScript and web content in an isolated WKWebView
privacy.credentials: No YouTube login credentials are requested or stored
privacy.youTubeConsentPreference: Only the accepted privacy and terms notice version is stored locally; pasted links and viewing history are not retained
privacy.youTubeDataAPITransport: The request query contains the parsed video identifier, the API key is sent in X-Goog-Api-Key, and Google necessarily receives ordinary HTTPS request/network metadata such as source IP
privacy.youTubeSessionStorage: Nonpersistent WebKit session cookies or player data may exist while playback runs; all website data is cleared before every embed and is never persisted
